claims.statement: A repeated public approval decision is rejected before all-action release and after consumption/completion and runtime reconstruction. Exact run/step/action/request/decision/use/set/head/member/receipt/artifact facts and relevant lifecycle audits remain unchanged. Rejected reuse creates no additional provider calls, attempts or effects.

At the exact expiry instant, pending approval and generation-zero reuse fail without authority mutation or calls. The real worker persists both expirations with no use, reservation or effect. Runtime reconstruction retains the expired state and generation-zero reuse remains rejected.

Public expiry renewal creates exactly one next-generation leaf per unchanged action with old-leaf linkage and identical action/hash/set/plan/revision/step scope. Renewal replay returns the same resource without mutation; old decisions stay rejected. Partial new approval makes zero calls; both new approvals execute two writes once and produce one unsent draft with exact proof/receipt joins.

Private database fault injection changes the destination, payload or binding of an already approved action while retaining its old hashes and decision. The sibling's public approval returns a sanitized no-store conflict without reflecting the canary. Raw persisted authority remains unchanged and no use, reservation, release, attempt, receipt, artifact or provider call occurs.

limitations: Five new cases use default local ASGI/runtime composition, fresh migrated and seeded SQLite, controlled time and original observed provider methods. Runtime close/reconstruction proves durable recovery in the same process, not an OS-process crash or real-provider delivery.

The three new changed-action cases mutate destination, payload or binding in private database storage; they do not simulate a supported public semantic-edit/replan API, which does not exist. Corrupt storage is never repaired to manufacture a successful control.

Bounded raw snapshots cover authoritative run/step/action/approval/authorization-set/head/member/effect records and selected lifecycle audits, excluding session and worker-claim bookkeeping. Hydrated action reads intentionally fail after corruption, so those negative proofs use raw records.

RUN-09 and Email/API/decision/boundary regressions supplement the new journeys with action-type, capability, plan/set, stale expected hash, authorization, concurrency, policy, rejection and expiry scenarios. New public cases alone do not claim every field permutation.

Only unchanged-action expiry renews a leaf; semantic changes require a new full authorization-set epoch. Current RUN-09 documentation is corrected to match existing tests without changing its historical feature, merge, branch, matrix statement/hash or exact-tree evidence.
All pytest gates run in-process with sockets denied except local Unix sockets. Local deterministic mocks establish no real external delivery or universal exactly-once guarantee. CI remains disabled.
